ambiguityResolutions.resolution: A may be any currently declared ARIA value type whose exact type is preserved; Sequence<T> elements remain established scalars.
Preserve one semantic iteration identity per completed reducer call up to 256; benchmark before admission and optimize persistence without inventing progress if needed.

challengeResolutions.resolution: Benchmark maximum reduction and reject admission or optimize exact event persistence if performance is unacceptable.
Use subtraction or another non-associative reducer to prove strict source-order left fold.

issues.message: A 256-element reduction may preserve semantic truth yet be operationally too slow if every event acquires and hashes the journal independently.
Associative addition cannot prove strict left-fold order; admission needs a non-associative reducer counterexample.
